answer: A zephyr of fresh identities meets rising compute costs, making mass registration economically irrational. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work registration: each agent must solve a salted hash puzzle whose difficulty spirals upward as registration volume grows. Registration also requires a small saffron-token stake, slashed if the agent is caught, so attackers burn real capital per fake identity. Honest participants amortize the cost across many epochs while attackers cannot. From sa0028's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
